utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Ira, have you heard about the repair drive? We’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now, and the fixing happens Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess—that helps. I’ll bring my socket set and screwdrivers, and I can take a Saturday morning table shift if you still need me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Ira, that would be wonderful—yes please, bring the socket set and screwdrivers, and I’ll put you down for a Saturday morning table shift.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Opal, if you’re able, could you help keep the Saturday list gentle and practical—urgent fixes first, then bikes, lamps, and mending as hands and tools allow?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I’ll mark the Saturday list that way: urgent fixes first, then bikes, lamps, and mending as tools and helpers are available.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Opal. Please keep it clear that even a small repair or a borrowed screwdriver counts—no one needs to stretch past what they can manage.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli, quick update—the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center; if you’re still available, could you help greet folks and point repairs to the right table?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday at the community center, then—thank you, Rosa. I can greet folks, but I’d like the hours and table list written down so I point everyone the right way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Eli—I’ll write up the Sunday hours and table list for you and make sure you have it before folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mara — I’m still piecing it together from neighbors, but I’ve heard the repair drive is Saturday morning in the community room, and folks are gathering tools, cords, gloves, spare screws, and a few handy fixers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That matches what I have, Nell — the fixing is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and we’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now. If you hear any urgent broken items or confirmed fixers, send them my way for today’s list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I’ll pass along 10 to 2 and send you any confirmed fixers or urgent broken items I hear about today.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, I’ve got the main bit and told my crew: broken lamps, chairs, small appliances, and bikes Saturday at 10 by the community room.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Bo—that outreach helps a lot. If you can, have them label anything with known issues so we can sort repairs faster Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll pass that along too—labels with what’s wrong, if they know, so you can sort faster Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Quinn, if I’m not mixing it up, we’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now, and the repair drive itself is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s right on the supplies and community room, Oren—but I still only have Saturday morning, not a confirmed 10 to 2 from Pia yet. Please share the basics, and I’ll send the exact time as soon as Pia confirms.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh! Thank you, Quinn—I’ll stop saying 10 to 2 for now and just share Saturday morning in the community room, with spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Gus, I’m updating the repair drive list for Sunday at the community center—we’re still short on spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and folks who can help with bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Cleo—I can bring a box of assorted screws, two extension cords, and extra work gloves, and I’ll ask around for bike and small-appliance helpers before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s perfect, Gus—I'll mark you down for screws, two extension cords, and work gloves, and I’d really appreciate any helper names you can send me before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rey, glad you’re checking in—the repair drive is Saturday morning in the community room, and I’m helping with setup and tools. Do you want me to put you down for a repair table or check-in?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Maybe check-in, if that’s useful—I’m better at quietly matching notes than handling a table. I’ve heard Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, with urgent home fixes as the main focus.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Check-in would be perfect, Rey—quiet note-matching is exactly what we need for triaging urgent fixes. I’ll put you down for Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and I’ll make sure you have the request list and labels.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, quick heads-up from Rosa: the repair drive has shifted to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the porch—does that still work for you or anyone you were planning to tell?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — yes, I can adjust. I’ll correct the word I already spread: Sunday at the community center, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo, that helps a lot—please mention it’s Sunday at the community center if anyone asks, and I’ll keep checking that the timing doesn’t clash with family pickup routines.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Hana, latest I can pass along is that the repair drive is prioritizing urgent home fixes, Tomas is set for Saturday morning, and Lila’s tools are still tentative.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — before I pass that on, can you confirm the location and what we’re collecting, especially whether small parts like screws and cords are included?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can’t confirm the location or the small-parts list yet, Hana — all I’ve got solid is urgent home fixes first, Tomas Saturday morning, and Lila’s tools still tentative.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Kira—sorry, I’m a bit scattered, but I’m still holding off until Pia confirms the time, place, and repair list; want me to check the signup sheet in the meantime?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, please check the signup sheet, but don’t treat it as final yet—let’s wait for Pia to confirm before we tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—I’ll just check the signup sheet for a rough idea and won’t pass anything along as final until Pia confirms.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, I still need the current repair list and the Saturday coverage gaps—what’s unassigned, and can you get the urgent items to me by tonight?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes—I’ll send you the urgent list tonight with owner names, and I’ll flag anything still unassigned separately. Right now I’m still firming up sign-in and drop-off setup, so I’ll include those coverage gaps clearly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—send it by 8 if you can, and mark sign-in and drop-off gaps separately so I can start filling them tonight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, I’m juggling a lot and only skimmed the repair drive notes—what’s the quick thing you’re able to help with?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I can help spread the word once Pia confirms the time, place, and what repairs they’re taking—can you confirm whether you’ve checked the porch table and community room for Opal yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Not yet—I only caught Opal’s ask, but I’ll do a quick porch table and community room check before the drive starts. Once Pia confirms the basics, I’ll nudge you so you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, I’m set to sort drop-offs for the first hour Saturday at 10 by the community room, and I can jump to sign-in if that’s still uncovered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, Dane—please handle drop-offs from 10 to 11, then switch to sign-in if no one’s there. We’re in the community room Saturday 10–2.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I'll cover drop-offs from 10 to 11, then check sign-in and fill in if it’s empty.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oren, I’ve only got Nell’s update so far: Saturday morning in the community room, and it may include tools plus small parts like cords, gloves, and spare screws. I’ll still check the notice before we announce it as final.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Hana — that matches what Tess told me: Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, with screws, extension cords, and work gloves welcome. I’ll hold off telling folks until you’ve checked the notice, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — that gives me a useful time window to verify. I’ll check the notice for Saturday 10 to 2 and confirm whether screws, extension cords, and work gloves are officially on the collection list before we tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey, quick update—the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center; could you help with intake at the drop-off table and keeping the pickup area tidy?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — I can help quietly with intake and keeping the pickup area tidy on Sunday. I’ll also pass along the new day to Mara and Cleo so their list stays current.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey—that’s perfect, and I really appreciate you letting Mara and Cleo know. I’ll have the intake labels and pickup signs ready for you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Eli — I’m mostly getting this second-hand, but it sounds like the repair drive is Saturday morning in the community room, and they’re collecting small broken stuff plus cords, gloves, spare screws, and anyone handy who can help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s mostly right, Nell: it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 in the community room, for small appliances, lamps, bikes, and mending projects. I’d hold off on saying cords and screws are confirmed unless Jules has put them on the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I’ll stick to Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room and the items you named, and I’ll wait on cords and screws until Jules confirms.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Opal, I’m coordinating tools and Saturday setup for the repair drive—do you need help with check-in, sorting repairs, or spreading the word?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam—yes, could you help me confirm where the repair kits, tool area, and sign-up sheets will be Saturday before we spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Opal—I’ll confirm the repair kits, tool area, and sign-up sheet spots today, then I’ll send you the details so we can share the right info.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Ira—sorry, I’m still a bit behind on the repair drive. Has Pia confirmed the time and what repairs we’re actually taking, or should I keep holding off?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard Pia’s final confirmation yet, Noah, but I wouldn’t hold off completely—sounds like Saturday is still on for urgent home fixes and small supplies. I’ll keep my socket set ready and let you know the minute I hear the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I’ll just say Saturday is tentative for urgent home fixes and small supplies, and make clear we’re still waiting on Pia for the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Faye, have you heard about the repair drive? We’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now, and the fixing is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I heard from Rosa that it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’d double-check before telling folks Saturday 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh thanks for flagging that, Faye—I’ll double-check right away before I keep spreading Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, I’ve got you for Saturday morning and your drill set, clamps, and hand tools. Can you help Pia sort the urgent repair list today so we know what’s still uncovered?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Mina—I’ll check in with Pia today and make sure the urgent fixes get names beside them; I did hear from Rosa it may have shifted to Sunday, so I’ll keep my tools ready either way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus—please confirm with Pia whether it’s Saturday or Sunday today, then send me the urgent list with names beside each fix.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m still firming up the room and exact hours, but we’re aiming for Saturday morning with bikes, small appliances, and simple mending—would anyone from your group want to help or bring something by?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I can ask my group for helpers and put out the call for spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves. I’d heard Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, so just confirm if that changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Mara—please frame 10 to 2 in the community room as tentative until I confirm it, and the screws, cords, and gloves would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not ready to have people spread it yet, Vik—I still need the office to confirm the community room, the accepted items, and whether we’ll have a sign-in sheet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Pia—I won’t spread the time, location, accepted items, or sign-in details until you confirm them. I’ll only keep saying urgent home fixes are the priority, Tomas is Saturday morning, and Lila’s tools are tentative.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik—that helps; I’ll check with the office today, and until then please keep even the tentative tool talk quiet so we don’t create confusion.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Cleo. I’m keeping it simple for Saturday—bikes, small appliances, clothing mends, and whatever tools or steady hands people can spare.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli—I’ll update it for Sunday at the community center, with bikes, small appliances, clothing mends, plus spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, tools, and steady hands on the needs list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo—just one small correction, it’s Saturday, not Sunday. The community center and the needs list sound right.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Jules—sorry, I’m still catching up. Do we have Pia’s confirmed time, place, and repair list now, or should I keep holding off on telling folks?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Keep holding off on anything firm for now, Noah—we’re still treating Saturday morning in the community room and the repair list as tentative until Pia confirms. If anyone asks, you can say we’re gathering interest and checking who might bring tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, Jules—I’ll keep it vague and just say we’re gathering interest for now. I won’t mention Saturday or the community room as firm until Pia confirms.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Bo, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? It’s 10 to 2 in the community room, and we’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — I’d only skimmed it, so Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and I’ll spread the word about screws, cords, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Bo, thank you — if anyone asks, remind them we’re trying to catch things before they get tossed, and the supplies can come by anytime before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Dane, I’m still waiting on Pia to confirm the repair drive time, place, and what they’ll take, so I wouldn’t pass anything along yet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Kira—I'll hold off on sharing details until Pia confirms. If you hear back, send me the time, place, and accepted items and I’ll help update everyone.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Dane—I’ll wait for Pia’s confirmation and send you only the confirmed time, place, and accepted items once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Gus — I’m still relying on everyone else’s updates, but I’ve got Saturday morning at the community room, you bringing spare tools, and Sam helping with tables. I’ll keep telling folks to bring small appliances, cords, gloves, spare screws, or themselves if they can fix things.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s exactly right, Nell—thanks for spreading the word. I’ll bring my spare tools Saturday morning, and anyone with fix-it skills or little parts to share will be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, Gus — I’ll keep passing that along, and if I hear of any extra fixers or parts, I’ll point them your way for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik, the repair drive is Saturday morning in the community room—we still need spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and anyone handy with bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Quinn — I’ll pass along that Saturday morning is in the community room, and we still need spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, plus bike and small-appliance helpers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thank you, Vik—just mention I’m still waiting on Pia’s confirmed time and final repair list, and I’ll update everyone as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mina, I can lend a socket set and screwdrivers, and I can take a table shift too—just tell me what time you need me Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday morning at 9 works—bring the socket set and screwdrivers labeled with your name. Can you also help Pia send me the urgent repair list tonight with an owner for each item?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I’ll be there Saturday at 9 with everything labeled, and I’ll check in with Pia tonight to help get you that urgent repair list with owners.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa, I’m keeping the repair drive list today—do you know any urgent broken items we should prioritize, or can you spare screws, extension cords, or work gloves for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara—quick update, it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday. Please prioritize lamps, chairs, and small appliances, and yes, I can spare screws and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll update the list to Sunday at the community center and prioritize lamps, chairs, and small appliances. I’ll also mark you down for screws and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rey, repair drive is Saturday 10–2 in the community room. Bring simple-fix items, spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, or any bike/appliance know-how.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo — I’ll pass that along to Mara and Cleo: Saturday 10–2 in the community room, with simple-fix items, screws, extension cords, work gloves, and bike or appliance help welcome.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks Rey. Send anyone with questions my way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, I’m helping coordinate Saturday morning setup for the repair drive and bringing tools—do you need me on check-in, tool sorting, or repairs first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sam, start with tool sorting first so repairs can move smoothly, and if Dane arrives we can put him on check-in. Let’s keep Saturday morning at the community room penciled in until Pia confirms it’s free.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Eli—I’ll start with tool sorting Saturday morning and keep the community room as penciled in until Pia confirms. If Dane shows up, I’ll point him toward check-in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Opal, I’m still going to verify the community room, drop-off plan, accepted items, and whether there’s a sign-in sheet before we update anything public.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Pia—I’ll keep the public list unchanged until you confirm the room, drop-off plan, accepted items, and sign-in sheet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal—I’ll check with the building office now and come back with only the confirmed details so we don’t get ahead of ourselves.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Faye — before I share anything about the repair drive, can you confirm the date, the repair categories, and whether we’re collecting tools only or small parts too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes — it’s Sunday at the community center, with the front porch as the main drop-off and pickup points at Maple Court and the laundromat bulletin board. I’ve heard tools and small parts are both being collected, but I’m still waiting on the exact repair categories before you share that piece.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — I’ll hold off on sharing the repair categories until you confirm them. For now I’ll note Sunday at the community center, front porch drop-off, and tools plus small parts being collected.
